scope: Publicly accessible article/archive pages, displayed metadata, contemporaneous reporting, and peer-reviewed prior work. No original WeChat backend records or authenticated first-publication snapshot obtained.

sources.title: 发哨子的人 — 端点星存档
observations: Page says original source is 人物.
Article body, credits, image references and archive/copyright note are visible.
Page's current displayed date is not an authenticated original publication timestamp.
limitations: Not the original Renwu WeChat publication.
Current page access does not authenticate original image bytes or version history.

sources.title: Coronavirus: Wuhan doctor speaks out against authorities — The Guardian
observations: Contemporaneous report describes Renwu removing the interview and copies quickly disappearing from Chinese social media.
Describes screenshots and variants including emoji, Morse code and pinyin.
limitations: News reporting is not platform audit logs.
Does not identify a complete command chain or establish the identity of every deletion actor.

sources.title: 发哨子的人：如果这些医生都能够得到及时的提醒，或许就不会有这一天 — yyrw.org.cn
observations: Current page contains substantial interview text and credits the source as 人物.
Title includes an additional quoted phrase compared with the Terminus title.
Page begins with an additional line '我爱我的祖国。' not seen at the same point in the currently read Terminus page.
Footer states '中欧国际医院管理中心主办' and '北京中欧国际医院管理技术研究院 版权所有'.
limitations: Displayed date does not prove the page was live on that date.
No authenticated 2020 snapshot or server record obtained.
Differences have not yet been compared paragraph-by-paragraph.
The host's institutional control and editorial authorization in 2020 are not independently confirmed.

sources.title: 中国生命关怀协会医院人文建设专业委员会简介 — yyrw.org.cn
observations: Page describes the committee as a first-level professional committee of China Life Care Association.
Page says the association is supervised by the National Health Commission and links to an NHC social-organization list.
limitations: Self-description is not independent proof of the site's legal owner, operational control, or 2020 governance.
The linked NHC page could not be retrieved by the current web reader in this session.

sources.title: Relay activism and the flows of contentious publicness on WeChat: a case study of COVID-19 in China
observations: Abstract describes textual analysis and participant observation of relay activism around the article, focusing on WeChat and GitHub.
Published paper's notes point to an item titled 'A hundred and eight versions'.
limitations: Full text methods and dataset were not reviewed in this audit because access was restricted.
The cited 108 figure is not an independently reconstructed sample count for this project.

sources.title: 《人物》原始微信公众号发布
observations: Multiple surviving sources report publication on 2020-03-10.
Terminus page links the original article as removed.
limitations: No authenticated original HTML, WeChat backend record, deletion log, or first-publication snapshot obtained.

research_gates.name: Register contemporaneous reporting and scholarly prior work
Acquire authenticated historical snapshots of original and derivative pages
Verify host/site governance and 2020 republication context
Review Sun & Wright methods/data for novelty boundary
Authorize a public article only if a distinct evidence-based contribution survives

stop_condition: If no authenticated temporal evidence or distinct version-provenance finding emerges beyond existing relay-activism literature, stop as a standalone article and reuse only as a methods appendix or case note.
